title: Aries doesn't do mixed signals.
caption: Ever dated someone as hard to read as a mystery light? Near Marfa, Libra is still squinting. Aries skips the guessing and says it plainly: dinner, 7pm, I'm driving. Send this to someone who needs to just say it.
